description: This file handles command-line argument parsing and container management for executing commands inside Docker or Podman containers, including resolving container states and building execution environments.

methods.name: parseCliContainerArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract container-related options and arguments.

methods.name: resolveCliContainerTarget
methods.description: Determines the container name from command-line arguments or environment variables.

methods.name: isContainerRunning
methods.description: Checks if a specified container is currently running using spawnSync.

methods.name: candidateContainerRuntimes
methods.description: Returns a list of container runtime configurations (podman and docker).

methods.name: resolveRunningContainer
methods.description: Identifies which container runtime is running the specified container.

methods.name: buildContainerExecArgs
methods.description: Builds the argument list for executing a command inside a container.

methods.name: buildContainerExecEnv
methods.description: Prepares environment variables for container command execution, removing host-specific overrides.

methods.name: isBlockedContainerCommand
methods.description: Determines if certain commands (like update) are blocked when running inside a container.

methods.name: maybeRunCliInContainer
methods.description: Main function to intercept CLI commands and reroute them to run inside a container if applicable.
